Results show that the ETS trading policy significantly improves participating plants' energy efficiency by 0.043, compared to non-ETS plants, while the announcement policy doesn't. Besides, several other methods are introduced to solve the potential autocorrelation and heteroskedasticity problems in the second-stage regression. Further, we unveil that the trading policy improves plants' energy efficiency by reducing coal consumption without affecting power generation. Finally, the heterogeneity analysis proves that China Southern Power Grid, local plants, and plants with high carbon prices benefit more from ETS.
articles.abstract_cn: 电厂正面临巨大的气候变化和政策风险。本文识别了中国碳排放交易体系（ETS）对电厂能源效率的影响。为此，我们采用两步法。第一阶段，我们运用元前沿随机前沿分析（MSFA）方法估算中国大型燃煤电厂的全要素能源效率。第二阶段，我们使用自举截断双重差分（BT-DID）估计量来考察ETS对电厂的影响。结果表明，与非ETS电厂相比，ETS交易政策显著提高了参与电厂的能源效率，提高了0.043，而公告政策则没有。此外，我们引入了其他几种方法来解决第二阶段回归中潜在的序列相关和异方差问题。进一步，我们揭示交易政策通过减少煤炭消耗而不影响发电量来提高电厂的能源效率。最后，异质性分析证明，中国南方电网、地方电厂和高碳价电厂从ETS中获益更多。

articles.title_en: Does energy consumption play a key role? Re-evaluating the energy consumption-economic growth nexus from GDP growth rates forecasting
articles.title_cn: 能源消费是否扮演关键角色？从GDP增长率预测重新评估能源消费与经济增长的关系
articles.abstract_en: Given the strong link between economic growth and energy consumption, we construct a new set of energy consumption indices (ECI) to forecast GDP growth rates. The findings demonstrate the strong predictive power of the new indices. In particular, the electricity consumption index from the industrial sector has an excellent predictive performance and deserves the attention of the government and academia to help formulate economic growth targets. The mixed-frequency model with the Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator approach (MIDAS-LASSO) enables the full exploitation of energy consumption information for stable forecasting performance, even in the context of crisis fluctuations and geopolitical risk shocks. Furthermore, we apply forecast encompassing tests and variable selection to statistically investigate the predictive information. By analyzing energy consumption characteristics, we contribute to the economic growth hypothesis at the level of energy consuming sectors and provide new insights into GDP forecasting.
articles.abstract_cn: 鉴于经济增长与能源消费之间的紧密联系，我们构建了一组新的能源消费指数（ECI）来预测GDP增长率。研究结果表明，新指数具有很强的预测能力。特别是，工业部门的电力消费指数表现出优异的预测性能，值得政府和学术界关注，以帮助制定经济增长目标。采用最小绝对收缩和选择算子方法的混频模型（MIDAS-LASSO）能够充分利用能源消费信息，实现稳定的预测性能，即使在危机波动和地缘政治风险冲击的背景下也是如此。此外，我们应用预测包含检验和变量选择来统计性地研究预测信息。通过分析能源消费特征，我们在能源消费部门层面为经济增长假说做出贡献，并为GDP预测提供新的见解。

articles.title_en: Toward high-resolution projection of electricity prices: A machine learning approach to quantifying the effects of high fuel and CO2 prices
articles.title_cn: 迈向高分辨率电价预测：一种量化高燃料和二氧化碳价格影响的机器学习方法
articles.abstract_en: The growing share of renewables, the retirement of coal generation, and the increasing significance (and price) of carbon emissions continue to reshape electricity market dynamics. Ongoing power sector transformations, along with recurrent energy price shocks, bring new challenges to electricity price prediction and projection. Adept at capturing nonlinear and time-varying dynamics of the power market, machine learning (ML) methods can significantly enhance modeling and projection capabilities. This paper leverages ML modeling to (1) analyze the day-ahead electricity price dynamics and (2) develop future price projections under varying market conditions. First, we offer a methodology for identifying and ranking the factors determining day-ahead power price behavior. Guided by the understanding of power price drivers, we then develop an ensemble ML model for high-resolution (i.e., for each day of the next year) electricity price projection. Hence, the first part of our analysis helps relate fundamental modeling approaches to ML studies, and the second part extends the existing literature, which is limited to high aggregation level (e.g., yearly basis) projections. High-resolution projections provide valuable insights into within-year price dynamics and help answer highly debated questions raised by the growing share of renewables and the current energy market turmoil. We demonstrate our methodology on the German power market, using data on 80 explanatory variables from 2015 to 2021. We identify the most critical power price drivers and develop an ML model to study the within-year impact of high fuel and carbon prices. Our findings indicate that the often-neglected interaction variables may significantly impact price projections and should be included in day-ahead electricity price modeling. We confirm the efficacy of our approach with a forecasting exercise based on day-ahead electricity prices in the first two quarters of 2022.
articles.abstract_cn: 可再生能源份额的不断增长、煤电的退役以及碳排放重要性（和价格）的日益提升，持续重塑着电力市场动态。持续的电力部门转型，加上反复出现的能源价格冲击，给电价预测和预测带来了新的挑战。机器学习（ML）方法擅长捕捉电力市场的非线性和时变动态，能够显著增强建模和预测能力。本文利用机器学习建模来（1）分析日前电价动态，以及（2）在不同市场条件下制定未来价格预测。首先，我们提供了一种识别和排序决定日前电价行为因素的方法论。在对电价驱动因素理解的基础上，我们开发了一个集成机器学习模型，用于高分辨率（即下一年的每一天）电价预测。因此，我们分析的第一部分有助于将基础建模方法与机器学习研究联系起来，第二部分则扩展了现有文献，这些文献仅限于高聚合水平（例如，年度基础）的预测。高分辨率预测为年内价格动态提供了宝贵的见解，并有助于回答由可再生能源份额增长和当前能源市场动荡引发的激烈争论的问题。我们在德国电力市场上展示了我们的方法论，使用了2015年至2021年间80个解释变量的数据。我们识别了最关键的电价驱动因素，并开发了一个机器学习模型来研究高燃料和碳价格的年内影响。我们的研究结果表明，经常被忽视的交互变量可能显著影响价格预测，应纳入日前电价建模中。我们通过基于2022年前两个季度日前电价的预测练习，证实了我们方法的有效性。

articles.title_en: The flow of industrial lifeblood: The impact of the West-to-East oil transportation project on enterprise performance of China
articles.title_cn: 工业血液的流动：西油东输工程对中国企业绩效的影响
articles.abstract_en: Based on the West-to-East oil transmission (WEOT) project, this paper uses the time-varying difference-in-differences method to empirically explore the impact of trans-regional oil and energy transmission strategy on the production performance of enterprises. The results reveal that the WEOT project significantly improves the production performance of enterprises along the route and enhances the production performance of other enterprises in neighboring cities as well as those in the same province. From the heterogeneity perspective, the WEOT project primarily improves private enterprises, enterprises in low-energy-dependent cities, non-labor-intensive enterprises, and enterprises in non-centrally supported industries. The results of the mechanism analysis show that the oil supply strategy primarily improves firms' production performance by improving enterprise productivity and promoting enterprise agglomeration. The research findings help to clarify the mechanism of interaction between energy supply and enterprise production performance, and provide empirical support for developing countries to navigate potential risks of energy supply shortage.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于西油东输（WEOT）工程，本文采用时变双重差分方法实证探讨跨区域石油和能源输送战略对企业生产绩效的影响。结果表明，WEOT工程显著提高了沿线企业的生产绩效，并提升了邻近城市以及同省其他企业的生产绩效。从异质性角度来看，WEOT工程主要改善了民营企业、低能源依赖城市的企业、非劳动密集型企业以及非中央支持行业的企业。机制分析结果显示，石油供应战略主要通过提高企业生产率和促进企业集聚来改善企业的生产绩效。研究结果有助于阐明能源供应与企业生产绩效之间的相互作用机制，并为发展中国家应对能源供应短缺的潜在风险提供经验支持。

articles.title_en: Energy affordability and subjective well-being in China: Causal inference, heterogeneity, and the mediating role of disaster risk
articles.title_cn: 能源可负担性与中国主观幸福感：因果推断、异质性及灾害风险的中介作用
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines how energy affordability affects the subjective happiness of Chinese households in the face of an extreme event that could affect the energy industry. We use two waves of nationally representative survey data to examine the variation in subjective happiness with the level of energy affordability. The results suggest that worsening energy affordability reduces household happiness. We also present robust evidence that energy affordability is also associated with where energy is sourced. We further show that this nexus is heterogeneous in that Eastern China households sense energy affordability as the key determinant of happiness. The perceived risk of extreme events moderates a household's subjective well-being when considering energy affordability. Our results call for a targeted approach to re-allocate economic benefits for alleviating energy poverty.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了在可能影响能源行业的极端事件面前，能源可负担性如何影响中国家庭的主观幸福感。我们利用两轮全国代表性调查数据，考察主观幸福感随能源可负担性水平的变化。结果表明，能源可负担性恶化会降低家庭幸福感。我们还提供了稳健证据，表明能源可负担性与能源来源地也有关。我们进一步表明，这种关系存在异质性，即中国东部家庭将能源可负担性视为幸福感的关键决定因素。在考虑能源可负担性时，极端事件的感知风险调节了家庭的主观幸福感。我们的研究结果呼吁采取有针对性的方法重新分配经济利益，以缓解能源贫困。

articles.title_en: Changing determinant driver and oil volatility forecasting: A comprehensive analysis
articles.title_cn: 变化中的决定因素驱动与石油波动率预测：一项综合分析
articles.abstract_en: Academic research relies on exogenous drivers to enhance the accuracy of forecasting oil volatility. Following the relevant literature, this study collects 62 exogenous drivers that reflect the movements of oil demand, oil supply, oil inventory, macroeconomic fundamentals, financial indicators, and measures of uncertainty. Our empirical results indicate that dimension reduction regressions, especially principal component analysis regression (PCA), successfully predict both WTI and Brent oil volatility at the one-month ahead forecast horizon. Shrinkage methods, on the other hand, outperform their counterparts for medium- and long-term forecast horizons. Furthermore, the unsupervised learning method (PCA) achieves superior forecasting performance during periods of oil price decrease, whereas supervised learning methods (i.e., shrinkage methods) significantly improve volatility accuracy. Additionally, the empirical results reveal that movements in the Kilian index, World industrial production index, global economic conditions index, U.S. steel production, Chicago Fed national activity index, capacity utilization for manufacturing, U.S. default yield spread, and MSCI emerging market index have a significant impact on oil volatility.
articles.abstract_cn: 学术研究依赖外生驱动因素来提高石油波动率预测的准确性。遵循相关文献，本研究收集了62个外生驱动因素，这些因素反映了石油需求、石油供应、石油库存、宏观经济基本面、金融指标和不确定性指标的变动。我们的实证结果表明，降维回归，尤其是主成分分析回归（PCA），在提前一个月的预测期内成功预测了WTI和布伦特原油的波动率。另一方面，收缩方法在中长期预测期内表现优于其对应方法。此外，无监督学习方法（PCA）在油价下跌期间实现了更优的预测性能，而有监督学习方法（即收缩方法）显著提高了波动率准确性。此外，实证结果揭示，Kilian指数、世界工业生产指数、全球经济状况指数、美国钢铁产量、芝加哥联邦储备银行全国活动指数、制造业产能利用率、美国违约利差和MSCI新兴市场指数的变动对石油波动率有显著影响。

articles.title_en: In search of distress premium in the Chinese energy sector
articles.title_cn: 探寻中国能源行业的困境溢价
articles.abstract_en: We explore the link between the Chinese firms' default probabilities and their stock returns with an emphasis on the energy sector. We show that energy stock portfolios sorted by probability of default (PD) demonstrate a return reversal pattern, in which the distressed energy portfolio earns a higher return than its adjacent portfolio. In contrast, PD-sorted portfolios for all Chinese A-share stocks demonstrate a strong distress anomaly puzzle. We find the energy sector distress premium, measured by buying distressed energy stocks and selling distressed stocks in other sectors, earns a significant return, and is not explained by the standard or energy factors. However, this premium is vulnerable to extreme market conditions. In a structural framework of credit premium, we exploit specific properties of the Chinese energy sector, such as the high proportion of state-owned enterprises (SOEs) and their importance to China's energy transition goals, to explain our empirical results.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了中国企业的违约概率与其股票回报之间的联系，重点关注能源行业。我们发现，按违约概率（PD）排序的能源股票投资组合呈现出收益反转模式，其中困境能源投资组合的收益高于其相邻投资组合。相比之下，按PD排序的所有中国A股股票投资组合则表现出强烈的困境异常之谜。我们发现，通过买入困境能源股票并卖出其他行业的困境股票所衡量的能源行业困境溢价，能获得显著收益，且这一溢价无法由标准因素或能源因素解释。然而，这种溢价容易受到极端市场条件的影响。在信用溢价的结构性框架下，我们利用中国能源行业的特定属性，如国有企业（SOEs）的高比例及其对中国能源转型目标的重要性，来解释我们的实证结果。

articles.title_en: Energy price bubbles and extreme price movements: Evidence from China's coal market
articles.title_cn: 能源价格泡沫与极端价格波动：来自中国煤炭市场的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates the factors behind the extreme price movements in China's coal market, with a particular focus on the impact of climate risk and energy transition in recent years. The Generalized Sup Augmented Dickey-Fuller (GSADF) method is employed to detect coal price bubbles, and a dynamic model averaging (DMA) approach is then used to analyze the causes of these price bubbles. The findings reveal that price bubbles in the Chinese coal market are mainly triggered by fluctuations in international energy prices. The extreme prices are rooted in supply-demand imbalances resulting from energy transition, economic development, and geopolitical conflicts. Policies aimed at adjusting coal supplies can effectively mitigate abnormal coal price fluctuations in China, while normal coal price fluctuations are significantly influenced by changes in energy demand driven by macroeconomic development. During the green transition towards renewable energy, the current high prices of fossil energy present challenges to China's energy supply security but also offer opportunities for the development of the renewable energy market. However, energy transition has facilitated the spread of price bubbles across coal, natural gas, and renewable energy markets, potentially leading to contagion effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了中国煤炭市场极端价格波动背后的因素，特别关注近年来气候风险和能源转型的影响。采用广义Sup增强迪基-富勒（GSADF）方法检测煤炭价格泡沫，并运用动态模型平均（DMA）方法分析这些价格泡沫的成因。研究结果表明，中国煤炭市场的价格泡沫主要由国际能源价格波动引发。极端价格根源于能源转型、经济发展和地缘政治冲突导致的供需失衡。旨在调整煤炭供应的政策可以有效缓解中国煤炭价格的异常波动，而正常的煤炭价格波动则显著受到宏观经济发展驱动的能源需求变化的影响。在向可再生能源绿色转型的过程中，当前化石能源的高价格对中国能源供应安全构成挑战，但也为可再生能源市场的发展提供了机遇。然而，能源转型促进了煤炭、天然气和可再生能源市场之间价格泡沫的传播，可能导致传染效应。

articles.title_en: The effects of polluting behaviour, dirty energy and electricity consumption on firm performance: Evidence from the recent crises
articles.title_cn: 污染行为、肮脏能源和电力消耗对企业绩效的影响：来自近期危机的证据
articles.abstract_en: We examine the effects of polluting behaviour, dirty energy, and electricity consumption on firms' profitability during the recent crises (climate change, 2016 oil crisis and COVID-19) using a dataset of around 40,000 Vietnamese firms from 2011 to 2020. More specifically, we study how firm-specific characteristics affect energy consumption, polluting behaviour, and profitability. Our results show that (1) dirty energy consumption has a positive impact on firm performance; (2) larger firms and firms located in industrial zones tend to exploit dirty energy more than others; (3) state-owned firms manage resources better than privately owned firms; and (4) polluting firms are more profitable. After controlling for the Paris Climate Agreement, we find smaller polluting firms are affected more intensely than other firms. We also find that electricity consumption negatively impacts firm profitability, but the impact was alleviated during the oil and COVID-19 crises. Finally, our results indicate that recent crises negatively affected firms' profitability in the electric power generation, transmission, and distribution sectors. The findings of this paper suggest that more stringent policies are required around dirty energy consumption, and these policies must target larger organisations—particularly in industrial zones.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用2011年至2020年间约40,000家越南企业的数据集，考察了近期危机（气候变化、2016年石油危机和COVID-19）期间污染行为、肮脏能源和电力消耗对企业盈利能力的影响。更具体地说，我们研究了企业特定特征如何影响能源消耗、污染行为和盈利能力。我们的结果表明：（1）肮脏能源消耗对企业绩效有正向影响；（2）规模较大的企业和位于工业区的企业往往比其它企业更多地利用肮脏能源；（3）国有企业比私营企业更好地管理资源；（4）污染企业更有利可图。在控制《巴黎气候协定》后，我们发现规模较小的污染企业受到的影响比其它企业更为强烈。我们还发现，电力消耗对企业盈利能力有负向影响，但在石油危机和COVID-19危机期间，这种影响有所缓解。最后，我们的结果表明，近期危机对电力生产、输电和配电部门的盈利能力产生了负面影响。本文的研究结果表明，需要围绕肮脏能源消耗制定更严格的政策，并且这些政策必须针对较大的组织——尤其是在工业区中的组织。

articles.title_en: Does energy efficiency of UK SMEs affect their access to finance?
articles.title_cn: 英国中小企业的能源效率是否影响其融资渠道？
articles.abstract_en: To effectively mitigate climate change, a crucial focus area is enhancing energy efficiency in firms and industries. This objective becomes even more imperative in light of the recent escalation in energy prices caused by the Russo-Ukrainian war. Given the limited financial resources of Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs), facilitating their access to finance becomes a potential avenue for reducing carbon emissions. Based on our knowledge, this is the first study that analyses the potential impact of energy efficiency on access to finance for SMEs in the UK. We consider a dataset of 2855 UK firms from 2015 to 2021 collected from the Longitudinal Small Business Survey. We find that energy efficient companies and firms that show energy saving behaviours are facing fewer credit constraints. These results are robust if we control for several company characteristics, including age, size, turnover, industry, location, and legal status.
articles.abstract_cn: 为有效缓解气候变化，一个关键的重点领域是提高企业和行业的能源效率。鉴于俄乌战争导致的近期能源价格飙升，这一目标变得更加紧迫。考虑到中小企业（SMEs）有限的财务资源，促进其融资渠道成为减少碳排放的一个潜在途径。据我们所知，这是首项分析能源效率对英国中小企业融资渠道潜在影响的研究。我们使用了从纵向小企业调查中收集的2015年至2021年间2855家英国企业的数据集。我们发现，能源效率高的企业和表现出节能行为的企业面临的信贷约束较少。在控制了包括年龄、规模、营业额、行业、地点和法律地位在内的多项公司特征后，这些结果依然稳健。

articles.title_en: Connectivity and spillover during crises: Highlighting the prominent and growing role of green energy
articles.title_cn: 危机期间的连通性与溢出效应：凸显绿色能源的突出且日益增长的作用
articles.abstract_en: How influential are green energy instruments? We examine how green- and carbon-energy assets differ regarding transmitting and receiving shocks between normal versus crises periods. Crises include the global financial crisis and Euro debt crisis, two waves of COVID-19, and the ongoing Russia-Ukrainian war. Our empirical illustration is based on volatility impulse function (VIRF) for dynamic conditional correlation–generalised autoregressive conditional heteroskedasticity (DCC-GARCH) method using daily data from January 03, 2007–March 31, 2023, of several green and brown energy instruments and market and energy controls, we evidence asymmetric connectedness that increases during crises. For specific green instruments, volatility transmissions can be transmitting or receiving. However, green instruments stand out overall as prominent transmitters, while brown energy instruments are prominent receivers. Results are consistent with green energy vehicles impacted by macroeconomic and market states and reflecting this to investors. Results are also consistent with green and brown interconnectivity. Further network analysis provides robustness to our study results and suggests this role is evolving. The study results are significant for policy intervention during the transition to alternative energy sectors and for risk and portfolio management implications.
articles.abstract_cn: 绿色能源工具的影响力有多大？我们考察了绿色能源资产与碳能源资产在正常时期与危机时期之间在冲击传递和接收方面的差异。危机包括全球金融危机和欧元债务危机、COVID-19的两波疫情，以及持续的俄乌战争。我们的实证说明基于动态条件相关-广义自回归条件异方差（DCC-GARCH）方法的波动率脉冲函数（VIRF），使用从一月 03，2007至三月 31，2023的日度数据，涵盖多种绿色和棕色能源工具以及市场和能源控制变量，我们证明了在危机期间不对称的连通性会增加。对于特定的绿色工具，波动率传递可以是传递或接收。然而，绿色工具整体上作为突出的传递者脱颖而出，而棕色能源工具则是突出的接收者。结果与绿色能源工具受到宏观经济和市场状态影响并将其反映给投资者的情况一致。结果也与绿色和棕色能源的互联性一致。进一步的网络分析为我们的研究结果提供了稳健性，并表明这一作用正在演变。研究结果对于向替代能源部门过渡期间的政策干预以及风险和投资组合管理具有重要意义。

articles.title_en: Assessing systemic risk and connectedness among dirty and clean energy markets from the quantile and expectile perspectives
articles.title_cn: 从分位数和期望分位数视角评估肮脏能源与清洁能源市场的系统性风险与关联性
articles.abstract_en: In response to environmental and climate change issues in recent decades, clean energy resources have been promoted as substitutes for fossil fuel-based dirty energy resources. While receiving great attention from environmentally conscious investors and policy-makers, the markets for the former energies could be affected by financial instability in the markets for the latter, which could lead to systemic risk and directional connectedness. In this paper, we aimed to assess potential systemic risk in such markets by employing conditional quantile- and conditional expectile-based Value-at-Risk (henceforth CoVaR and CoEVaR, respectively). Due to their definition through expected conditional asymmetric loss functions, we adopted Kabaila’s efficient method for the computation of conditional expectations and proposed a backtesting technique based on Diebold and Mariano’s test. Using Delta-CoVaR and Delta-CoEVaR, we constructed conditional tail risk networks to describe the directional tail risk connectedness. We revealed that the CoVaR and CoEVaR for almost all pairs of energy markets had the best forecast accuracy when computed using a copula exhibiting symmetric tail dependence with asymmetric and heavy-tailed margins. Compared to CoVaR, CoEVaR possessed a relatively better conditional coverage performance in several cases, complementing its advantage of being more sensitive to (extreme) loss magnitude. In addition, we found crude oil, heating oil, and sectoral clean energy indices to be highly interconnected, but the connectedness weakened following the 2015 Paris Climate Agreement. In particular, crude oil and the renewable energy sector played a consistent role as the most systemically important net receiver and net transmitter, respectively. These results provided important implications for policy-makers and investors aware of systemic risk and connectedness among dirty and clean energy markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 为应对近几十年来环境和气候变化问题，清洁能源资源已被推广为化石燃料类肮脏能源资源的替代品。在受到具有环保意识的投资者和政策制定者高度关注的同时，清洁能源市场可能受到肮脏能源市场金融不稳定的影响，从而导致系统性风险和方向性关联。本文旨在通过采用条件分位数和条件期望分位数风险价值（分别简称CoVaR和CoEVaR）来评估此类市场的潜在系统性风险。由于它们是通过期望条件非对称损失函数定义的，我们采用了Kabaila的高效方法计算条件期望，并提出了一种基于Diebold和Mariano检验的回测技术。利用Delta-CoVaR和Delta-CoEVaR，我们构建了条件尾部风险网络来描述方向性尾部风险关联。我们发现，对于几乎所有能源市场对，当使用具有对称尾部依赖且边缘分布非对称和重尾的copula计算时，CoVaR和CoEVaR具有最佳的预测精度。与CoVaR相比，CoEVaR在若干情况下具有相对更好的条件覆盖表现，补充了其对（极端）损失幅度更敏感的优势。此外，我们发现原油、取暖油和行业清洁能源指数高度互联，但在2015年《巴黎气候协定》之后，这种关联性有所减弱。特别是，原油和可再生能源部门分别持续扮演着最具系统重要性的净接收者和净传递者的角色。这些结果为关注肮脏能源与清洁能源市场系统性风险和关联性的政策制定者和投资者提供了重要启示。

articles.title_en: The impact of green finance on energy transition: Does climate risk matter?
articles.title_cn: 绿色金融对能源转型的影响：气候风险是否重要？
articles.abstract_en: With increased concerns regarding environmental deterioration and a growing understanding of the need for sustainable development, measures to promote energy transition (ET) have become a hot issue among academics and policymakers. In contrast to previous ET research, this study explores the impact of green finance (GF) on China's ET by considering the role of climate risk in the period from 2011 to 2020. Our results indicate that GF development has a significant impact which accelerates ET, and the effects are heterogenous, demonstrating that GF is more likely to be instrumental in driving ET in regions with more advanced socioeconomic circumstances and more favorable sustainable development environments. We also find that climate risk has a moderating role and a threshold effect on the GF–ET nexus is evident, indicating that climate risk has an unfavorable role in accelerating energy transformation. These findings offer valuable insights into advancing the sustainable ET and suggests that the government specifically prioritize the impact of climate risk in the development and deployment of a GF framework.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着对环境恶化问题的日益关注以及对可持续发展必要性的认识不断加深，促进能源转型（ET）的措施已成为学术界和政策制定者关注的热点问题。与以往关于能源转型的研究不同，本研究在2011年至2020年期间，通过考虑气候风险的作用，探讨了绿色金融（GF）对中国能源转型的影响。我们的结果表明，绿色金融的发展对加速能源转型具有显著影响，且这种影响存在异质性，表明在经济社会条件更为先进和可持续发展环境更为有利的地区，绿色金融更有可能在推动能源转型中发挥作用。我们还发现，气候风险具有调节作用，且绿色金融与能源转型之间的关系存在明显的门槛效应，表明气候风险在加速能源转型中起到了不利作用。这些发现为推进可持续能源转型提供了有价值的见解，并建议政府应特别重视气候风险在绿色金融框架制定和实施中的影响。

articles.title_en: Time-varying jump intensity and volatility forecasting of crude oil returns
articles.title_cn: 时变跳跃强度与原油收益波动率预测
articles.abstract_en: Modelling and forecasting of crude oil volatility have been widely examined using GARCH-type models, and evidence suggests the presence of time-varying jumps in the crude oil market. This paper proposes a novel approach to model and forecast crude oil volatility by incorporating two time-varying jump intensities (State-dependent and Hawkes process) into the GARCH-Jump model. Our in-sample and out-of-sample analysis demonstrates that considering jump intensity as an explanatory variable significantly enhances the forecasting accuracy of WTI and Brent crude oil volatility. For WTI crude oil volatility, the more complex the jump intensity model, the better its forecasting power. For Brent crude oil volatility, the picture is different, indicating that the non-linear characteristics of volatility provide more informative forecasts. Further analysis shows that, during the COVID-19 crisis period, the Hawkes Jump Intensity (HJI)-GARCH model consistently improves the volatility forecasting performance. These results highlight the importance of jump intensity in modelling and predicting crude oil price volatility.
articles.abstract_cn: 原油波动率的建模与预测已广泛采用GARCH类模型进行研究，证据表明原油市场存在时变跳跃。本文提出了一种新方法，通过将两种时变跳跃强度（状态依赖和霍克斯过程）纳入GARCH-Jump模型来建模和预测原油波动率。我们的样本内和样本外分析表明，将跳跃强度作为解释变量显著提高了WTI和布伦特原油波动率的预测准确性。对于WTI原油波动率，跳跃强度模型越复杂，其预测能力越强。对于布伦特原油波动率，情况有所不同，表明波动率的非线性特征提供了更具信息量的预测。进一步分析显示，在COVID-19危机期间，霍克斯跳跃强度（HJI）-GARCH模型持续改善了波动率预测性能。这些结果强调了跳跃强度在建模和预测原油价格波动率中的重要性。

articles.title_en: Peer governance effects of information security breaches
articles.title_cn: 信息安全 breaches 的同行治理效应
articles.abstract_en: Peers' information security risks may have sent negative signals to the market, thus forcing firms to strengthen their internal control governance. Solow's paradox, however, suggests that when information technology (IT) investment does not reach equilibrium, firms may still blindly increase IT investment while neglecting information security management. Using the unique information security breaches data released by the China National Information Security Vulnerability Database (CNVD), we find that the peers' information security breaches have a governance effect on firm internal control. The underlying mechanism is that peer information security breach increases the cost of proprietary information and reputation maintenance. In addition, we find that the above peer governance effects are more significant in samples with higher agency conflicts, high-tech industries, and higher supply. Further, our further analysis also shows that the peer governance effects of information security breaches positively affect firms' investment efficiency. Overall, our findings verify the peer governance effects of the information security breaches.
articles.abstract_cn: 同行的信息安全风险可能向市场发出负面信号，从而迫使企业加强其内部控制治理。然而，索洛悖论表明，当信息技术（IT）投资未达到均衡时，企业可能仍盲目增加IT投资，而忽视信息安全管理。利用中国国家信息安全漏洞库（CNVD）发布的独特信息安全漏洞数据，我们发现同行的信息安全漏洞对企业内部控制具有治理效应。其潜在机制是同行信息安全漏洞增加了专有信息和声誉维护的成本。此外，我们发现上述同行治理效应在代理冲突较高、高科技行业和供应较高的样本中更为显著。进一步分析还表明，信息安全漏洞的同行治理效应对企业投资效率产生积极影响。总体而言，我们的研究结果验证了信息安全漏洞的同行治理效应。

articles.title_en: Climate risk performance and returns integration of Chinese listed energy companies
articles.title_cn: 气候风险表现与中国上市能源公司收益整合
articles.abstract_en: Traditional energy and new energy stock returns are becoming more closely related under the energy transition constraint. In this paper, the core correlation between traditional energy stock returns and new energy stock returns in China is portrayed using the minimum spanning tree (MST) approach and the integration characteristics of energy companies are dynamically analyzed. On this basis, we identify the impact of climate factors on the integration of energy markets by constructing a GARCH-MIDAS model with three dimensions: climate concern, climate physical risk, and climate policy. We find that returns are more likely to be transmitted within traditional energy industries and new energy industries, and firms with the same characteristics tend to form clusters. In a dynamic context, the degree of energy system integration has significant time-varying characteristics and is susceptible to unforeseen events, market policies, and supply-demand relationships. In addition, there is heterogeneity in the effect of climate concern on the integration between traditional energy and new energy markets, and the effects of both climate physical risk and climate policy on the integration of the energy system are significantly negative.
articles.abstract_cn: 在能源转型约束下，传统能源与新能源股票收益的相关性日益增强。本文采用最小生成树（MST）方法刻画中国传统能源股票收益与新能源股票收益之间的核心相关性，并动态分析能源公司的整合特征。在此基础上，通过构建包含气候关注、气候物理风险和气候政策三个维度的GARCH-MIDAS模型，识别气候因素对能源市场整合的影响。我们发现，收益更可能在传统能源行业和新能源行业内部传导，具有相同特征的企业倾向于形成集群。在动态背景下，能源系统整合程度具有显著的时变特征，且易受突发事件、市场政策和供需关系的影响。此外，气候关注对传统能源与新能源市场整合的影响存在异质性，而气候物理风险和气候政策对能源系统整合的影响均显著为负。

articles.title_en: Towards Paris Climate Agreement goals: The essential role of green finance and green technology
articles.title_cn: 迈向巴黎气候协定目标：绿色金融与绿色技术的核心作用
articles.abstract_en: Probing the essential role of green finance (GF) and green technology (GT) is crucial to achieving the Paris Climate Agreement goals. The investigation utilises the wavelet-based quantile-on-quantile regression method to capture the comprehensive interrelation among GF, GT and the progress towards Paris Climate Agreement goals (PCA). The quantitative analyses indicate that GF and GT exert favourable impacts on PCA at the high and low quantiles in the short run, underlining that green finance and green technology could facilitate the realisation of Paris Climate Agreement goals, but the adverse effects in several cases contradict this opinion. In addition, GF and GT's positive and negative impacts on PCA are weakened in the medium term, and their stimulatory effects are also shown in the long-run scenario. Through comparing the impacts of GF and FT on PCA, and find that green finance contributes more towards the Paris Climate Agreement goals than green technology. Against the backdrop of increasingly severe climate changes and risks, these discussions could put forward meaningful lessons to realise the Paris Climate Agreement goals by developing green finance and green technology.
articles.abstract_cn: 探究绿色金融（GF）和绿色技术（GT）的核心作用对于实现巴黎气候协定目标至关重要。本研究采用基于小波的quantile-on-quantile回归方法，以捕捉GF、GT与巴黎气候协定目标（PCA）进展之间的全面相互关系。定量分析表明，在短期内，GF和GT在高分位数和低分位数上对PCA产生有利影响，强调绿色金融和绿色技术能够促进巴黎气候协定目标的实现，但在某些情况下的不利影响与此观点相悖。此外，GF和GT对PCA的正负影响在中期有所减弱，其刺激效应在长期情景中也有所体现。通过比较GF和FT对PCA的影响，发现绿色金融对巴黎气候协定目标的贡献大于绿色技术。在气候变化和风险日益严峻的背景下，这些讨论可为通过发展绿色金融和绿色技术实现巴黎气候协定目标提供有意义的启示。

articles.title_en: Financial market development and corporate risk management: Evidence from Shanghai crude oil futures launched in China
articles.title_cn: 金融市场发展与企业风险管理：来自中国上海原油期货上市的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the impact of China's crude oil futures (COF) on risk management at the firm level in China. The empirical results based on a sample from 2014 to 2021 show that the launch of China's COF significantly reduces idiosyncratic risk in energy-dependent firms, and this conclusion remains significant even after a series of robustness tests. Mechanism analysis reveals that the launch of China's COF reduces firms' idiosyncratic risk mainly through the cash flow and volatility within the corporate internal channels and the attention from external market information channels. Further analysis finds that the inhibitory effect is more pronounced among large firms and firms with higher competitive pressures. Our study contributes firm-level evidence on the relationship between China's COF and corporate risk management and provides insights into energy policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了中国原油期货（COF）对中国企业层面风险管理的影响。基于2014年至2021年样本的实证结果表明，中国原油期货的上市显著降低了能源依赖型企业的特质风险，且这一结论在经过一系列稳健性检验后仍然显著。机制分析揭示，中国原油期货的上市主要通过企业内部渠道的现金流和波动性以及外部市场信息渠道的关注度来降低企业的特质风险。进一步分析发现，这种抑制作用在大企业和竞争压力较高的企业中更为明显。我们的研究为中国原油期货与企业风险管理之间的关系提供了企业层面的证据，并为能源政策提供了见解。

articles.title_en: How carbon risk affects corporate debt defaults: Evidence from Paris agreement
articles.title_cn: 碳风险如何影响企业债务违约：来自《巴黎协定》的证据
articles.abstract_en: There is an increasing concern in traditional energy industries (e.g., oil and coal) due to the high carbon emissions they produce. In an attempt to achieve carbon emission reduction, governments have launched various policies to restrict the use of fossil energy sources. While carbon regulation aims to encourage high‑carbon firms to accelerate their green governance transition, the carbon risk hypothesis argues that these instruments may raise compliance costs and the risk of financial default for the firms. This paper uses the exogenous shock of China's accession to the Paris Agreement as an identification strategy to test the relationship between carbon risk and corporate debt default. We find that the risk of debt default for high‑carbon firms decreases significantly after carbon regulation compared to low-carbon firms. Promoting green transformation, reducing financial leverage, and increasing legal compliance are proven to be three crucial mechanisms. Further analysis shows that this effect is heterogeneity between the different levels of government environmental governance pressure, financial market attention, industry competitive pressure, and media scrutiny. Our study provides novel evidence for promoting sustainable development in the conventional energy industries represented by oil through environmental regulation.
articles.abstract_cn: 传统能源行业（如石油和煤炭）因其产生的高碳排放而日益受到关注。为了实现碳减排，各国政府出台了各种政策来限制化石能源的使用。虽然碳监管旨在鼓励高碳企业加快其绿色治理转型，但碳风险假说认为，这些工具可能会提高企业的合规成本和财务违约风险。本文利用中国加入《巴黎协定》的外生冲击作为识别策略，检验碳风险与企业债务违约之间的关系。我们发现，与低碳企业相比，高碳企业在碳监管后的债务违约风险显著降低。促进绿色转型、降低财务杠杆和提高法律合规性被证明是三个关键机制。进一步分析表明，这种效应在政府环境治理压力、金融市场关注度、行业竞争压力和媒体监督的不同水平之间存在异质性。我们的研究为通过环境监管促进以石油为代表的传统能源行业的可持续发展提供了新的证据。

articles.title_en: Now or later: The long tail effect of household income on energy consumption
articles.title_cn: 现在还是以后：家庭收入对能源消费的长尾效应
articles.abstract_en: In residential buildings, energy-using appliances support nearly all domestic needs, such as heating, cooling, cooking, lighting, and entertainment, and constitute the bulk of household energy consumption. However, decoupling between purchasing energy-using appliances and consuming energy may run counter to the basic expectation of the income consumption curve based on the most established theory of utility. Instead, we expect a long-tailed curve with a left deviation, that is, the long tail effect of income on household energy consumption. We thus rigorously examined the long tail effect by describing the changes in energy consumption against increasing household income. Three empirical studies demonstrate a possible intrinsic mechanism, and four heterogenous tests investigate the extrinsic incentives. Evidently, when considering the priority in household bundles, the decoupling of purchasing energy-consuming appliances and energy consumption leads to a long tail effect. Without intervention, households with higher income are less persuaded to purchase energy-saving products than households with lower income. Moreover, extrinsic incentives can influence intrinsic appeal and the long tail effect. We advance the conceptual and practical understanding of the exceptional consumption pattern of household energy, which is an indispensable and low-priority consumption in household bundles. The findings can provide researchers and policymakers with more detailed theoretical and practical instructions on how to encourage different households to form low-energy consumption patterns and apply energy-efficient appliances.
articles.abstract_cn: 在住宅建筑中，用能设备支撑着几乎所有的家庭需求，如供暖、制冷、烹饪、照明和娱乐，并构成家庭能源消费的主体。然而，购买用能设备与消费能源之间的脱钩可能与基于最成熟的效用理论的收入消费曲线的基本预期相悖。相反，我们预期一条左偏的长尾曲线，即收入对家庭能源消费的长尾效应。因此，我们通过描述能源消费随家庭收入增加的变化，严格检验了长尾效应。三项实证研究展示了一种可能的内在机制，四项异质性检验考察了外在激励。显然，当考虑家庭消费束中的优先级时，购买耗能设备与能源消费的脱钩导致了长尾效应。在没有干预的情况下，高收入家庭比低收入家庭更不愿意购买节能产品。此外，外在激励可以影响内在吸引力和长尾效应。我们推进了对家庭能源这一在家庭消费束中不可或缺但优先级较低的消费的特殊模式的概念和实践理解。研究结果可以为研究人员和政策制定者提供更详细的理论和实践指导，以鼓励不同家庭形成低能耗模式并应用节能电器。

articles.title_en: Corporate ESG rating divergence and excess stock returns
articles.title_cn: 企业ESG评级分歧与股票超额收益
articles.abstract_en: ESG rating have progressively become an important reference index within the investment decision-making process. However, divergence might arise among diverse ESG rating agencies when appraising the same company. Such divergence affects investors' perception of a companies' ESG performance, consequently affecting its excess stock returns. This paper delves into the mechanics behind ESG rating divergence on excess stock returns based on the ESG rating data encompassing Shanghai and Shenzhen A-share listed companies in China spanning from 2018 to 2022. The research reveals the following findings: Firstly, ESG rating divergence negatively impact stock excess return rates. Investor sentiment, ESG improvement potential and information transparency play a positive moderating role in the influence of ESG rating divergence on excess stock returns. Secondly, there are heterogeneity characteristics in the impact of ESG rating divergence on excess stock returns. Companies that actively disclose ESG reports, low-carbon companies, companies with QFII, and those with high divergence and high rating experience a greater impact form ESG rating divergence on their excess stock returns. Thirdly, the social rating divergence has the greatest impact on excess stock returns, followed by environmental and governance levels.
articles.abstract_cn: ESG评级已逐渐成为投资决策过程中的重要参考指标。然而，不同的ESG评级机构在评估同一家公司时可能会出现分歧。这种分歧影响投资者对公司ESG表现的认知，进而影响其股票超额收益。本文基于2018年至2022年中国沪深A股上市公司的ESG评级数据，深入探讨了ESG评级分歧对股票超额收益的作用机制。研究发现：第一，ESG评级分歧对股票超额收益率产生负面影响。投资者情绪、ESG改善潜力和信息透明度在ESG评级分歧对股票超额收益的影响中发挥正向调节作用。第二，ESG评级分歧对股票超额收益的影响存在异质性特征。积极披露ESG报告的公司、低碳公司、有QFII持股的公司以及高分歧高评级的公司，其股票超额收益受ESG评级分歧的影响更大。第三，社会评级分歧对股票超额收益的影响最大，其次是环境与治理层面。

articles.title_en: Impacts of ICT penetration shaping nonworking time use on indirect carbon emissions: Evidence from Chinese households
articles.title_cn: 信息通信技术渗透对非工作时间使用影响间接碳排放的作用：来自中国家庭的证据
articles.abstract_en: People's time use is crucial for carbon emissions related to lifestyles. Increasing the adoption of information and communication technology (ICT) in everyday life changes time-use patterns and, thus, affects emissions. This study proposes a two-way fixed effects model following the stochastic impacts by regression on population, affluence, and technology (STIRPAT) framework to explore the impacts of ICT penetration and household average weekly nonworking time on household indirect emissions. Based on 2010–2018 panel data from the Chinese Family Panel Studies (CFPS), the results show that a 1% increase in household average weekly nonworking time can lead to a 0.169% decrease in emissions by substituting consumption with time. In contrast, a 1% increase in the proportion of family members using a mobile phone or the proportion of family members surfing the internet can increase emissions by 0.107% or 0.127% by increasing electricity and communication consumption. ICT penetration moderates the relationship between nonworking time and emissions, which suggests that ICT amplifies the impact of nonworking time by reducing the consumption of activities and shaping the time-use pattern to be less carbon intensive.
articles.abstract_cn: 人们的时间使用对于与生活方式相关的碳排放至关重要。日常生活中信息通信技术（ICT）采用的增加改变了时间使用模式，从而影响排放。本研究提出一个双向固定效应模型，遵循随机影响回归于人口、富裕度和技术（STIRPAT）框架，以探讨ICT渗透和家庭平均每周非工作时间对家庭间接排放的影响。基于2010-2018年中国家庭追踪调查（CFPS）的面板数据，结果表明，家庭平均每周非工作时间增加1%可以通过以时间替代消费导致排放减少0.169%。相反，家庭成员使用手机的比例或上网的比例增加1%可以通过增加电力和通信消费使排放增加0.107%或0.127%。ICT渗透调节了非工作时间与排放之间的关系，这表明ICT通过减少活动消费和塑造时间使用模式使其碳密集度降低，从而放大了非工作时间的影响。

articles.title_en: Climate change, energy security risk, and clean energy investment
articles.title_cn: 气候变化、能源安全风险与清洁能源投资
articles.abstract_en: We examine the impact of climate change on energy security risk and explore the role of clean energy investment in reducing this impact. By exploiting a recently developed historical energy security risk dataset alongside climate change and clean energy investment datasets, we demonstrate that climate change enhances energy security risk. Additionally, we show that investment in clean energy can reduce the impact of climate change on energy security risk. This mitigating effect of clean energy investment is more pronounced in countries with slower population growth, the capacity to invest in robust energy infrastructures, and lower corruption practices. To optimize the role of clean energy investment in reducing the impact of climate change, it is crucial to establish robust energy systems, control population growth, maintain higher environmental standards, and limit corruption practices, among other measures.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了气候变化对能源安全风险的影响，并探讨了清洁能源投资在减少这种影响中的作用。通过利用最近开发的历史能源安全风险数据集以及气候变化和清洁能源投资数据集，我们证明气候变化加剧了能源安全风险。此外，我们表明清洁能源投资可以降低气候变化对能源安全风险的影响。这种清洁能源投资的缓解效应在人口增长较慢、有能力投资于稳健能源基础设施以及腐败程度较低的国家更为显著。为了优化清洁能源投资在减少气候变化影响中的作用，建立稳健的能源系统、控制人口增长、维持更高的环境标准以及限制腐败行为等措施至关重要。

articles.title_en: Carbon emission efficiency of 284 cities in China based on machine learning approach: Driving factors and regional heterogeneity
articles.title_cn: 基于机器学习方法的中国284个城市碳排放效率：驱动因素与区域异质性
articles.abstract_en: The rational categorization and assessment of carbon emission efficiency (CEE) and its drivers are crucial for coping with the global climate crisis. To address the bias of univariate modeling and challenge of ignoring the heterogeneity of drivers across cities, this study explores differences between carbon emission drivers across different types of cities and regions to reveal the spatial distribution characteristics of urban CEE and heterogeneity of emission reduction potential. We use a non-radial, non-directional relaxation measure-based directional distance function (SBM-DDF) model to assess the CEE of 284 cities over the period from 2006 to 2020. Machine-learning algorithms are applied to identify city characteristics to determine the effects of city- development types and their characteristic drivers. The results of the driver analysis show that energy consumption, gross regional product, spatial area, and population size are the key factors influencing in the heterogeneity of cities' CEE, with an importance ranking of 0.578, 0.507, 0.432, and 0.418, respectively. The results of for the heterogeneity of the cities' heterogeneity further confirm that energy consumption has the greatest impact on energy-dependent cities (EDCs), economic-development cities (ECDCs), and low-carbon potential cities (LPCs), whereas among the Low-carbon growth cities (LCGs), science, technology, and innovation, urban greening, and electricity consumption play an important roles in promoting greening and low- carbon development, which can help to determine the low- carbon development model for each type of city. Finally, energy consumption affects cities in the central region more than in the eastern and western regions. Based on the results of estimating the heterogeneity of urban carbon- emission rates, we propose customized emission- reduction development pathways to guide urban low-carbon development and formulate carbon- reduction policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 合理分类和评估碳排放效率（CEE）及其驱动因素对于应对全球气候危机至关重要。为解决单变量建模的偏差以及忽视城市间驱动因素异质性的挑战，本研究探讨了不同类型和区域城市间碳排放驱动因素的差异，以揭示城市CEE的空间分布特征和减排潜力的异质性。我们使用基于非径向、非方向性松弛测度的方向性距离函数（SBM-DDF）模型评估了2006年至2020年间284个城市的CEE。应用机器学习算法识别城市特征，以确定城市发展类型及其特征驱动因素的影响。驱动因素分析结果表明，能源消耗、地区生产总值、空间面积和人口规模是影响城市CEE异质性的关键因素，其重要性排名分别为0.578、0.507、0.432和0.418。城市异质性结果进一步证实，能源消耗对能源依赖型城市（EDCs）、经济发展型城市（ECDCs）和低碳潜力型城市（LPCs）的影响最大，而在低碳增长型城市（LCGs）中，科技创新、城市绿化和电力消耗在促进绿色低碳发展方面发挥重要作用，这有助于确定每类城市的低碳发展模式。最后，能源消耗对中部地区城市的影响大于东部和西部地区。基于城市碳排放率异质性估计结果，我们提出了定制化的减排发展路径，以指导城市低碳发展和制定碳减排政策。

articles.title_en: Has the healthy city pilot policy improved urban air quality in China? Evidence from a quasi-natural experiment
articles.title_cn: 健康城市试点政策是否改善了中国的城市空气质量？来自准自然实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: Air pollution has caused serious consequences, and improving air quality has become a major global challenge. The environmental improvement of a healthy city is widely recognized, but quantitative assessment of its effect is still relatively rare. In the context of the “Healthy China” strategy, this paper considers the healthy city pilot (HCP) policy in China as a “quasi-natural experiment.” Based on the panel data of 288 prefecture-level cities from 2009 to 2020, a difference-in-differences strategy is used to examine the effect of the HCP policy on urban air quality. Our results show that the HCP policy effectively decreases PM2.5 by 6.8%, dust by 6.0%, SO2 by 2.4%, and CO2 emissions per capita by 8.8%. The findings continue to hold after a series of robustness tests. Mechanism analysis shows that the HCP policy significantly decreases industry pollutant discharge, increases city innovation, promotes efficient energy use and transformation, and improves public transport system and green infrastructure. These mechanisms play an important role in improving air quality. Furthermore, the HCP policy greatly improved air quality in regions with substantial populations, low financial pressure, high Internet development, and medical levels. In summary, the government must review the results of implementing the HCP policy and incrementally expand the number of healthy cities. Increasing the weighting of air quality in policy assessment and strictly implementing a mechanism that combines incentives and disincentives.
articles.abstract_cn: 空气污染已造成严重后果，改善空气质量已成为全球重大挑战。健康城市的环境改善作用已被广泛认可，但对其效果的定量评估仍相对较少。在“健康中国”战略背景下，本文将中国的健康城市试点（HCP）政策视为“准自然实验”。基于2009年至2020年288个地级市的面板数据，采用双重差分策略检验HCP政策对城市空气质量的影响。结果表明，HCP政策有效降低了PM2.5浓度6.8%、粉尘浓度6.0%、SO2浓度2.4%以及人均CO2排放量8.8%。经过一系列稳健性检验后，研究结论依然成立。机制分析表明，HCP政策显著减少了工业污染物排放，提升了城市创新能力，促进了能源的高效利用和转型，并改善了公共交通系统和绿色基础设施。这些机制在改善空气质量方面发挥了重要作用。此外，HCP政策在人口众多、财政压力低、互联网发展水平高和医疗水平高的地区显著改善了空气质量。总之，政府必须审查HCP政策的实施效果，并逐步扩大健康城市的数量。在政策评估中提高空气质量的权重，并严格执行激励与约束相结合的机制。

articles.title_en: Renewable technology adoption costs and economic growth
articles.title_cn: 可再生能源技术采用成本与经济增长
articles.abstract_en: In the presence of rapid technological progress, early technology adoption may result in large capital replacement costs. We develop an analytical Integrated Assessment Model that incorporates endogenous scrapping costs resulting from new technology adoption in renewable energy, as well as externalities associated with carbon emissions and renewable technology spillovers. We use our calibrated model to investigate the effects of the scrapping channel on renewable technology adoption and on the optimal energy transition. In the absence of a Pigouvian carbon tax, a second-best policy that incentivizes renewables through internalizing spillovers provides relatively small benefits and can even be detrimental to short-run growth. In contrast, the reduction in fossil fuel consumption resulting from internalizing technology spillovers is significantly larger if the Pigouvian tax is also in place. Comparing the status quo to the scenario where both policies are implemented results in a consumption-equivalent welfare gain of 1.4 percent. Our findings suggest that, in the presence of scrapping costs resulting from rapid technological progress, some caution might be warranted before concluding that direct subsidies are a suitable substitute for a Pigouvian carbon tax. When it comes to social welfare, carbon taxes and policies that promote renewables by eliminating spillover externalities are best thought of as complements rather than substitutes.
articles.abstract_cn: 在快速技术进步的情况下，早期技术采用可能导致巨大的资本重置成本。我们开发了一个分析性综合评估模型，该模型纳入了可再生能源新技术采用产生的内生报废成本，以及与碳排放和可再生能源技术溢出相关的外部性。我们使用校准后的模型来研究报废渠道对可再生能源采用和最优能源转型的影响。在没有庇古碳税的情况下，通过内部化溢出效应来激励可再生能源的次优政策带来的收益相对较小，甚至可能对短期增长有害。相比之下，如果同时实施庇古税，内部化技术溢出导致的化石燃料消费减少显著更大。将现状与两种政策都实施的情景进行比较，消费等价福利收益为1.4%。我们的研究结果表明，在快速技术进步导致报废成本存在的情况下，在得出直接补贴是庇古碳税的合适替代品的结论之前，可能需要谨慎。就社会福利而言，碳税和通过消除溢出外部性来促进可再生能源的政策最好被视为互补品而非替代品。
